title.en: Dr. Sunghwan Park appointed professor at Hoseo University

body.ko: 박성환 박사가 호서대학교 특임교수로 임용되었습니다. 축하합니다!
body.en: Dr. Sunghwan Park has been appointed professor at Hoseo University. Congratulations!

body.ko: 연구실에서 학부연구생으로 함께한 주성용 학생이 PwC에 입사했습니다. 축하합니다!
body.en: Seongyong Ju, an undergraduate researcher in our lab, has joined PwC. Congratulations!

title.ko: 장예슬 박사과정생, EMNLP 2026 Industry Track 논문 게재 확정
title.en: Paper accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track

body.ko: 장예슬 박사과정생의 논문 「CARE: Bounded Selective Evidence-to-Judgment Routing for Cost-Aware Document Security Classification」이 EMNLP 2026 Industry Track에 accept 되었습니다.
body.en: “CARE: Bounded Selective Evidence-to-Judgment Routing for Cost-Aware Document Security Classification” by Ph.D. candidate Yeseul Chang has been accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track.

title.ko: 장예슬 박사과정생, CIKM 2026 Short Paper 게재 확정

body.ko: 장예슬 박사과정생의 논문 「ConRAC-SE: Evidence-Agreement Routing for Cost-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Security Classification」이 CIKM 2026 Short Paper로 accept 되었습니다.
body.en: “ConRAC-SE: Evidence-Agreement Routing for Cost-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Security Classification” by Ph.D. candidate Yeseul Chang has been accepted as a short paper at CIKM 2026.
